title: Create an advanced alert rule in Grafana

blocks.content: Welcome to the advanced alert rule learning path. This path walks you through creating a Grafana-managed alert rule using Advanced mode—with multiple queries, an expression pipeline, a recovery threshold, and a custom alert condition.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Switch from Default to Advanced mode in the alert rule form
- Add multiple queries that feed into an expression pipeline
- Use Reduce and Math expressions to transform and compare query results
- Configure a recovery threshold to prevent alert flapping
- Set the alert condition on a specific expression
- Save the rule and verify it evaluates correctly

## Before you begin

Before you create an advanced alert rule, ensure you have:

- A Grafana Cloud account with Editor or Admin role. To create one, refer to [Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/get/).
- At least one data source sending metrics to Grafana Cloud (Prometheus, Mimir, or TestData)
- Completed [Introduction to Grafana Alerting](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub/basic-alerting/) or equivalent experience creating alert rules in Default mode

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.

## More to explore

We understand you might want to explore other capabilities not strictly on this path. We'll provide you opportunities where it makes sense.
